function.name: move_to
function.arguments: {"targets": {"x": -0.05, "y": 0.012, "z": 0.95, "gripper": 0}, "note": "Measured eef advanced only 9 mm of the 8 cm commanded, so the servo lags ~2-3 mm per control step and the number of steps per call is set by the largest normalised dimension change (the 0.48 gripper swing in call 1 bought 39 steps). I therefore pair the 8 cm lateral step towards my best estimate of the block (x=-0.05) with a gripper-close command to get many control steps of travel; this also tests the axis sign: if +x is away from the base the hand should move in the side view towards the block."}
